messages:
michael (oncall): :rotating_light: Pager alert: eu-west GPU pool reporting sustained saturation (gpu-util 92%) and OOMs on inference nodes. Customers seeing higher 95th latency. Paging infra oncall.
opsbot: ALERT: eu-west-gpu-pool - 92% avg GPU util, evictions=12 in last 5m, errors: 504x30. Link: https://alerts.internal/p/1723456789
camille: on it. quick check: are we seeing network flaps or pure capacity? metrics show inflight requests up 2.3x and batch growth. probably steady traffic surge + a bad KV cache warm state.
ajay: KV cold misses + big sequence lengths. recommend partial traffic diversion to NA to relieve EU while we warm caches and add capacity. avoid full cutover to preserve affinity.
sophie: agree. if we change GSLB weights we should lower DNS TTL to speed changes. current TTL=300s. propose TTL=30s during the op window.
camille: plan: 1) set GSLB weights: eu-west -> 70, na-west -> 30 (canary), ttl=30 2) spin up 4 extra eu-central GPU nodes for burst capacity 3) enable light quantized fallback for heavy requests in eu (model variant) 4) monitor errors for 10min then ramp/divert further.
ajay: commands:
```
# canary divert
redwoodctl gslb set-weight --region eu-west=70 --region na-west=30 --ttl 30 --meta "incident:1723456789"
# enable q4 fallback for chat-model-prod in eu
redwoodctl model set-variant --model chat-prod --region eu-west --variant q4_0_light
```
sophie: tagging customer-affinity: we must exclude dedicated/reserved customers from diversion. camille can you add the exemption list to the policy?
camille: doing that now. `gslbctl policy add-exempt --customer customer_42 --region eu-west`
deploy-bot: ROUTE CHANGE OK — gslb weights updated (eu-west=70, na-west=30), ttl=30. change-id: gchg-20260320-01
hana: support: two enterprise tenants reported latency spikes ~10:45UTC (tenant ids T-102, T-305). They've been notified that we're diverting some traffic and provisioning extra capacity.
leo: product note — ensure session-stickiness for premium customers isn't broken by diversion. we still want session->model affinity if possible.
ajay: warmed KV cache will take ~6-8 minutes of traffic. if errors go down to <2% we can slowly repatriate. if error rate increases >5% for 3 consecutive minutes, rollback plan: set weights back to 95/5 and ttl=300, then open ticket for pool reprovision.
camille: spinning up 4 nodes in eu-central-1 now (req id: prow-1723). estimated burst cost ~ $50/hr total — approved for incident window.
sophie: dashboards: https://grafana.internal/d/eu-gpu/1723456789 — set alert to auto-notify on error_rate>5% for 3m.
michael (oncall): thanks team. owners: camille (traffic + infra), ajay (runtime changes), sophie (SRE monitoring). I'll update the incident ticket INC-1723456789 with actions and timeline. keep updates here. :thumbsup:
